property_summary: For any call sending exactly 10 ether on a block number divisible by 15, the contract pays out its entire balance so address(c).balance becomes 0; the mutant only pays when block.number % 15 != 0, so it retains the balance for such blocks.
On any block whose number is not divisible by 15, a valid 10-ether call leaves the contract's balance intact (no payout); the mutant pays out exactly on such blocks, draining address(c).balance to 0.

For any admissible input, a call to fallback with a value other than exactly 10 ether must revert; the mutant, having lost the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check, accepts such calls and completes them, so some fuzzed amount breaks the rule.
